newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Islamist PM Erbakan says he resigns.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Islamist PM Erbakan says he resigns.

text.p: Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, the first Islamist to lead modern Turkey, said on Wednesday he had resigned in a power-sharing deal with his pro-Western coalition allies.
"A short while ago I presented my resignation to the president," Erbakan told reporters after a 45-minute meeting with President Suleyman Demirel.
Erbakan earlier held talks with coalition ally Tansu Ciller and a rightist leader on a proposed caretaker government to take the country into early elections under Ciller's leadership.
The one-year-old coalition's parliamentary majority has dissolved in an anti-Islamist onslaught led by the secularist armed forces.

The proposed transfer of power, which still faces a host of procedural and political obstacles, was announced earlier this month in a bid to defuse the crisis with the military, which accuses Erbakan of fostering Islamic activism.
